components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button (e.g. Run check, Save).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #ffffff; background: #4338ca; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3730a3; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #3730a3; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action alongside a primary button (e.g. Cancel).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #1e2030; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d9ddec; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eef0f8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { background: #ebecfe; outline: none; }

components.name: Verdict Chip
components.description: Pill showing a check's verdict (ai_generated / human_written / uncertain) with a redundant colored dot.
components.css: .ds-chip-flag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; background: #fdeede; color: #924a0a; } .ds-chip-flag .ds-chip-dot { height: 7px; width: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #924a0a; }

components.name: Result Card
components.description: Floating content card for a check result or the single-check form.

Check result

Score, verdict, and evidence render here.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; padding: 28px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(30,32,48,0.08); font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e2030; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: #585d75; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d9ddec; background: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1e2030; padding: 10px 12px; transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7a7f96; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input:focus-visible { background: #ebecfe; border-color: #4338ca; outline: none; }

components.name: Model Status Badge
components.description: Signature component: shows detector-service health via a colored dot + monospace status text, visually distinct from verdict chips.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; align-self: flex-start; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #d9ddec; background: #ffffff; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #585d75; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-dot { height: 7px; width: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1a7038; }

narrative.overview: Prompt Patrol reads as an instrument panel for a serious, evidence-based decision — not a consumer dashboard. A fixed deep-indigo sidebar acts as the deck's control column: wordmark, navigation, and identity anchored in one place while the workspace beneath it stays a calm, near-white surface tuned for reading and comparing evidence. Score readouts, timestamps, and detector status render in monospace (DM Mono) against a sans-serif (Figtree) interface voice, giving numeric/technical facts a distinct, deliberate register from prose and UI copy. Color is otherwise conserved. The palette is a single indigo family (primary, accent, and their soft/border steps) doing almost all of the UI's decorative work, with saturated color spent only where it carries meaning: the three verdict colors (flag/human/unsure) and the three detector-status colors (ready/warming/down) are deliberately separate token families from each other and from the neutral indigo chrome, so a 'service is up' signal and a 'flagged as AI' signal can never be mistaken for one another.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed indigo command-column sidebar; flat, light workspace for content
Verdict and status color are their own token families — never reused for decoration
Numeric/technical facts always render in DM Mono; everything else in Figtree
Flat by default; shadow reserved for surfaces that float above the workspace
Precise, restrained component feel — no scale/glow theatrics on hover or focus

rules.name: The Reserved Signal Rule
rules.body: Verdict colors and detector-status colors are separate token families from each other, even where hex values coincide. Never reuse a verdict token to express detector status, or vice versa.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Outside of verdict/status signal and the danger family, every color in the interface comes from the indigo hue family. Pull from the existing scale before introducing a new hue.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Facts Rule
rules.body: If a piece of text is a number, timestamp, or system-reported status the instructor did not type themselves, render it in DM Mono. If it's UI copy, render it in Figtree.

rules.name: The Flat-Workspace Rule
rules.body: Structural chrome (sidebar, nav rows, table rows, page background) never uses box-shadow. Shadow is earned only by content that's meant to feel like a floating artifact.

dos: Do render every score, timestamp, or system-reported value in DM Mono; render every authored label/copy in Figtree.
Do reuse the existing indigo scale for any new neutral or accent need before introducing a new hue.
Do give verdict and detector-status their own token families even when a hex value would coincide with another family.
Do use shadow-md/shadow-xl only for content that visually floats above the flat workspace.
Do keep the radius scale to rounded-md/lg for controls, rounded-xl for containers, rounded-full for state indicators.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow to structural chrome (sidebar, nav rows, table rows, page background).
Don't express focus state as an outline/ring; every interactive element defines an explicit focus-visible background/border shift instead.
Don't reuse a verdict color token to represent something that isn't a verdict, or a status color token for something that isn't detector health.
Don't introduce a sharp (0px) or heavily rounded (>12px) corner anywhere in the system.
